name: pi-branches
description: Canvas-style conversation branching on pi-durable: a server, a web client, and a terminal client

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && svelte-check --workspace web --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && svelte-check --workspace web --tsconfig ./variants/tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.build:demo: vite build --config web/vite.config.ts --mode demo --outDir dist-demo && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning scripts/inline-demo.ts
scripts.build:variant: vite build --config web/variants/vite.config.ts --mode demo && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning scripts/inline-demo.ts web/variants/$VARIANT/dist pi-branches-$VARIANT
